text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** A tray lunch with a shredded cabbage-and-carrot slaw (with some chicken), six maki sushi rolls, a mixed fruit cup, orange juice, and small cups of soy sauce and pickled ginger. The slaw, sushi, and fruit are the main meal, so I include the drink and condiments as well.

**STEP 2 - Vessels:**
- Slaw: side plate, ~20 cm (area ~314 cm²)
- Sushi: smaller plate, ~18 cm (area ~254 cm²)
- Fruit: cereal-type bowl, ~15 cm (area ~177 cm²)
- Juice: glass, roughly 75% full (~180 ml)

**STEP 3 - Items:** shredded slaw with chicken, maki sushi (salmon, cucumber, avocado, cream cheese), mixed fruit (strawberry, watermelon, grape, blueberry), orange juice, soy sauce, pickled ginger.

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Slaw covers ~60% of its plate (~190 cm²)
- Sushi covers ~35% of its plate (~90 cm²)
- Fruit covers ~75% of its bowl (~130 cm²)

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Slaw: 190 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 380 ml
- Sushi: 90 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 270 ml
- Fruit: 130 cm² × 2.5 cm ≈ 330 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Slaw: 380 ml × 0.4 ≈ 150 g (shredded cut vegetables, with air gaps)
- Sushi: 270 ml × 0.6 ≈ 170 g (rice-based rolls are airier than dense meat, so I used a lower density than the dense range; six maki of ~28 g each agrees)
- Fruit: 330 ml × 0.5 ≈ 170 g
- Juice: ~180 g
- Soy sauce: ~10 g; pickled ginger: ~15 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Slaw: 150 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 75 kcal
- Sushi: 170 g × 150 kcal/100 g ≈ 255 kcal
- Fruit: 170 g × 50 kcal/100 g ≈ 85 kcal
- Juice: 180 g × 45 kcal/100 g ≈ 81 kcal
- Soy sauce: 10 g × 53 kcal/100 g ≈ 5 kcal
- Pickled ginger: 15 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 6 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Total ≈ 695 g and ≈ 507 kcal. That is plausible for a sushi lunch with fruit and juice. The slaw is lightly dressed, so I did not add mayonnaise energy. Error is likely ±25%.
